customer: hey so my hatchback is actualy titled under my dads small busines, not me. can i still sell it to northwind and do i get the money?
agent: You can sell it, but since the car is titled to a business, whoever signs has to be authorized to sell company property. Please bring form NW-BUS-1 (the business signing authority letter) signed by an officer of the company, along with your photo ID and the company's tax ID number (EIN). Payment goes to the business rather than the person signing, by direct deposit into the business bank account. You can find more details in our article "When and how you get paid."
